name: New profile
notes: A blank Acquire connection profile. Names only: tables or views and their columns, never SQL.
server: host name or IP, optionally \INSTANCE and ,port. database: the Acquire database. Windows sign-in only.
collar / survey: the table or view and the column for each role. Use a database view if the data needs joins.

assay.layout: 'wide' (one row per sample interval, one column per analyte), 'long' (one row per result, with element and value columns on the same table as hole / from / to), or 'long_joined' (results table joined to a samples table by sample ID).

assay.preferred: when a sample has several results for one analyte, keep the one with the 'lowest' or 'highest' value in a priority column, or the 'first'; 'none' stops the import if there are duplicates.
assay.bdl: optional below-detection flag column, the flag values, and how to write those results: 'half' (half the value), 'negative', or 'as_is'.
assay.qaqc: optional column and the values to leave out (blanks, standards, duplicates).
assay.column_rules: optional renaming of analyte columns (drop columns, drop or strip name suffixes, rename).
filters: the collar columns behind each filter; leave one empty (null) to hide that filter.
dip: 'negative_down' if downward holes have negative dips, else 'positive_down'.
